product_one_liner.value: Aviso AI is an AI-powered revenue platform for sales and go-to-market teams that combines forecasting, pipeline and deal intelligence, conversation insights, and revenue operations tools to help teams grow and predict revenue.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as an end-to-end AI revenue platform for GTM and revenue teams.

pricing_page.notes: Aviso has a public pricing page that describes personalized plans and offers a custom proposal/demo request, even though prices are not displayed.

named_customers.notes: Aviso explicitly identifies these organizations as customers in its career posting.

employee_band.notes: The Aviso AI LinkedIn company profile lists a company size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Aviso's about information gives Redwood City, California; its LinkedIn profile also identifies Redwood City as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Aviso's own press release states it was founded in 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is a general marketing/product blog, and its technical architecture/AI articles include work by Aviso's Research & Content Manager rather than an identified engineering author. It does not meet the criterion for an engineering/technical blog by engineers.

public_docs.notes: Aviso has a public help center with multiple product guides and articles across areas such as getting started, administration, integrations, and customer success.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open positions list includes engineering and a data engineer role, but no role title matching AI, machine learning, data science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4o; Google Gemini and Gemma are also named as models Aviso uses or supports in its AI approach.
model_provider.notes: Aviso describes a mix of closed-source models and internally hosted open-source models; the cited post names GPT-4o, Gemini, and Gemma.

compliance_certs.notes: Aviso's compliance page claims SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliance. GDPR is a compliance regime rather than a certification, but is included because the question explicitly lists it.

last_funding.notes: Aviso announced an $8 million extended Series B led by Storm Ventures on July 31, 2019.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round located was the July 2019 extended Series B, well before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Aviso's careers page lists an Account Executive opening, and the posting page invites applications.

launched_6mo.notes: Aviso announced its AI CSM product on June 16, 2026, within the six-month window from 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page lists executives and VPs but gives no join dates; no dated appointment or departure in the 12-month window could be verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Aviso's integration information and product materials name these CRM platforms; public help documentation also has an integration guide for Microsoft Dynamics.
